description: Land Acquisition - Parana Halpe, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices about specific land parcels being acquired by the state, including property descriptions, locations, extents, and compensation amounts deposited with the court. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" including "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes). There is no government personnel or structural content that would trigger Types 1-3, and it doesn't fit any other specialized categories.
